name: SportsMOT: Multi-Actor Tracking in Sports Scenes
description: SportsMOT is a large-scale multi-object tracking benchmark focused on fast-paced, multi-actor movements in team sports broadcasts. It comprises 240 video clips across three sports categories: basketball, football (soccer), and volleyball. While informal README estimates cite ~485 frames/clip (~116,400 frames), the official sequence metadata and ICCV 2023 publication report exactly 150,379 frames (average 626.6 frames/clip) and 1,629,664 bounding boxes. The dataset captures key challenges in athletic tracking, including high-speed player movements, non-linear trajectories, abrupt direction reversals, shared team jerseys, and rapid pan-tilt-zoom camera motion. Annotated with bounding boxes and identities following the MOT Challenge format, partitioned into 45 train clips (28,574 frames), 45 validation clips (26,970 frames), and 150 test clips (94,835 frames).
